_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: No upside breaker (ETF flows~0, CVD soft, momentum mid-50s) and no downside breaker either; coil base-rate favors holding the current rung.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/coil; narrative silent on forward phase but skew widening is compatible with caution, not a directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G stays 45-60, funding near flat, 30d momentum mid-50s, no ETF-flow or CVD impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: momentum >70 with F&G>65 and positive ETF flows (up to Optimism) OR price break with F&G<40, negative funding and elevated skew/VIX (down to Disbelief)
